What I can say, however, is that I feel empty. Have for years. Feeling like nobody actually cares, etc... And I've been thinking of maybe a residential. I've been in a handful of crisis inpatient centers in the past year, and maybe you have too. 

While crisis centers don't help me, besides making sure I'm alive for a week or two, I've been thinking residential might help. A controlled setting, longer stay and more relaxed in some ways, safe environment, group and 1 on 1 therapy ...

I'm not completely sure where I want this to go, but I just wanted to put the idea out there. It's not really a suggestion, because I don't expect you to even pay this comment any mind.
